articles.headline: Indonesian shares rally as foreign investors post strong net buy amid rupiah appreciation
articles.body: JAKARTA (Reuters) - Indonesian equities surged as foreign institutional investors recorded significant net buy across blue-chip banking and consumer counters. A stronger rupiah and resilient GDP growth outlook boosted market confidence.
